definition: The sample standard deviation of the last window log returns from close to close, per bar and not annualised.
boundaries: Reads closes only, so it sees about a fifth of what a bar's range carries; scale it by the square root of bars per year to annualise.
recognition: Higher means bigger moves from bar to bar.

class_meanings.index_cfd: A return across a session close, a weekend or a contract roll is a gap, not a bar's move; bind the statistic to bars inside one session or a back-adjusted series, or it reads the gap.
